newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to higher.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely steady at the short end of the curve, while the six-month and one-year maturities strengthened, traders said on Friday.
A trader said banks took a cue from the overnight money market which remained wedged at 10.53125 percent as the Central Bank maintained its borrowing at 10.5 percent and lending at 13 percent.
"That's why swap points on short term maturities were steady," said one trader. Banks, however, were cautious on their medium and long term outlook, the trader added.
